content.text:
The drawing shows methylenediphosphonic acid. A central CH2 carbon links two phosphorus atoms. Each phosphorus carries one double-bonded oxygen (P=O) and two hydroxyl groups (OH).

No wedges, hashes or cis/trans geometry are drawn, so the SMILES has no stereochemistry.

SMILES: O=P(O)(O)CP(=O)(O)O
